faq.q: Can you still buy a cheap house in Greece near the beach?
faq.a: Yes, but expect compromises. Within this budget you usually find studios, small apartments or older houses, either a short walk from the sea or in quieter villages. Use the price and distance-to-sea filters together to see what is available today. Expect smaller spaces.

faq.q: What can I buy in Halkidiki for under €150,000?
faq.a: Typically a studio or small apartment near the coast, a small older house, or a village home that needs work. Larger homes close to the beach are usually above this budget. Listings change often, so check the list below or ask us to send you new homes that match.

faq.q: Are cheap houses in Greece a good investment?
faq.a: They can be, if the legal status is clean and the total cost, including renovation, makes sense. Nobody can promise a return. Have a lawyer check the title and permits, and an engineer check the building, before you sign. Think about running costs too.

faq.q: What extra costs come with a cheap property in Greece?
faq.a: As of November 2026: transfer tax of 3.09% on a resale, plus lawyer, notary and land-registry fees, typically several percent in total. Then add renovation, legalisation of unpermitted spaces, utility connections and the annual ENFIA property tax. Our lawyer confirms the figures for each case.

body:
Affordable apartments and studios

Studios and small apartments are the most common homes in this budget, often in small buildings near holiday villages. They make an easy holiday base and are simple to lock up when you leave.

Cheap houses near the beach in Halkidiki

Small houses close to the sea do appear in this range, usually older, smaller or in less famous villages. Being a few streets back from the beach often makes the biggest difference to the price.

Village houses to renovate

Older houses in inland villages can be bought at lower prices, but budget for renovation. Have an engineer check the structure, the roof and the legal status before you sign.

Property in Greece under €100,000

Homes under €100,000 exist, mostly studios, small apartments and village houses. Filter by price to see what is available today.

Hidden costs of buying cheap property

As of November 2026, to be confirmed by our lawyer, transfer tax on a resale is 3.09%, and lawyer, notary and land-registry costs typically add several percent. Add renovation, legalisation of any unpermitted spaces, furniture and the annual ENFIA property tax.
